lines.text: A father tells his son to pay attention to his wisdom so he may maintain discretion.
The forbidden woman's speech is smoother than oil, but in the end she is bitter as hyssop.
The father says to keep far from her door, lest Midianites feast on your wealth.
The father says to drink water from your own cistern and rejoice in the wife of your youth.
The LORD examines all a man's paths, and the wicked man dies for lack of discipline.
